Rule.name: OAuth Token Syslog Padding Oracle Demo
Rule.Description: Issues or accepts a baseline OAuth bearer token, decrypts the encrypted payload using a Syslog-only padding oracle (calls OAuthTokenValidator as REST would, reads sailpoint.object.SyslogEvent for BadPaddingException vs post-padding failures), forges a same-length extended expiration via CBC malleability, and validates the forged token through OAuthTokenValidator.authenticate.
